sourceChecks.text: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:7で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:19で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:25で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI1:42で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:22で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord GOD’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:26で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to the LORD, that he might fulfill the LORD’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:27で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 1KI2:35で本文が対象人物を名指す、または明確に同じ人物を指す。

sourceChecks.text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
